description: Original ST1221 numerical functions remain unchanged in analysis_core.py. Optional bounded per-region scale fitting and an adjustable scale-magnitude ranking penalty are implemented in scale_fitting.py. phase_comparison.py conservatively withholds phase labels for competing fits of identical detected evidence. FFT processing and peak detection are unchanged.
limits: Bounded low-index HCP/BCC library; other structures are not tested.
Compatibility scores are not phase probabilities.
Fourier support is not phase fraction.
Automatic searches are bounded and not guaranteed global optima.
Two-scale HCP fits have more flexibility. The scale-magnitude penalty is not a statistical correction for the number of fitting parameters.
A zone containing no c-sensitive reflections cannot determine HCP c.
The shared-evidence ambiguity guard is conservative and heuristic; it is not calibrated statistical model selection.
Scale penalty is an adjustable quadratic preference relative to reference dimensions, not a measured strain limit; calibration offsets can affect ranking.

extensions.scale_fitting.py: Automatic uniform HCP/BCC or independent HCP basal/c reciprocal scales. Same bounded zones, wider reflection band, scale bounds 0.85–1.15. Each fitted hypothesis receives an optional mean squared scale-deviation penalty before ranking and zone selection. Default strength 0.10 per 5% adjustment, zero disables; fitted positions are unchanged by the ranking cost. Distinct zone hypotheses can be retained for the same observed profile set.
extensions.phase_comparison.py: shared-evidence-v1: reports matched/unsupported prediction counts and adds an exact-shared-profile ambiguity guard. Operates on the rank score supplied by fitting; does not adjust positional scores, simulate intensities, assume allowed reflections must be present, or automatically prefer the sparser model.
